feeds.title: Kaizen Health Group » Massage Therapy
feeds.description: We are patient-centered and offer services to address the root cause of disease prevention and chronic illness. As an Integrative Medical Clinic who's primary care providers treat patients for a variety of conditions, using therapies that are non-invasive, safe, and effective It is the best Massage Therapy Center in Mississauga, which offers a wide range of massage therapy services to help promote the well-being of the mind and body.

feeds.title: Apex Massage Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Our team of professionally trained registered massage therapists, provides therapeutic massage therapy. Schedule when your time allows, we are open 7 days a week. We focus on our client's needs and goals for optimum wellness.

feeds.title: Vicars School of Massage Therapy Blog
feeds.description: At Vicars School of Massage Therapy, you will get a massage therapy education that meets the highest national standards- on a schedule that fits your life. Our blended-learning classes require you to be in a classroom four days a month for intensive, hands-on instruction. Outside of these class dates, you will work from home, following our exclusive materials online on the Moodle platform.

feeds.title: Big Feet Blog
feeds.description: Big Feet started operating in the Vancouver West area in 2002. Big Feet Group is highly recognized by municipal governments, regulatory agencies, and communities across the entire Greater Vancouver District. Big Feet enjoys a great reputation for its significant size of work force, professional services, affordability, clean shops at convenient locations, promotions and rewards, and friendly customer care.

feeds.title: RMTAO Blog
feeds.description: The RMTAO exists to advance the massage therapy profession in Ontario. The RMTAO has worked to advocate MTs and provide resources and opportunities to help RMTs improve their knowledge, navigate the latest research and grow their practice. Find resourceful knowledge from experts, events, seminars and much more here.

feeds.title: Richard Lebert Massage Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Massage Therapy Blog by Richard Lebert, who's a Registered Massage Therapist and Educator. The RMT Education Project is to help people manage sports injuries with health education. This blog features posts on massage therapy, acupuncture, myofascial release, pain science, cupping, IASTM & more.

feeds.title: Myocare Registered Massage Therapy Blog
feeds.description: MyoCare is a Boutique Clinic that provides clients with Massage Therapy Treatments designed for you & your health concerns. Our Therapists are trained to treat muscular, joint, neurological, and stress-related pain. Read the blog posts to learn more about Deep Tissue Massage, Jaw Massage Therapy, and Acupuncture.

feeds.title: Dora Jackson
feeds.description: My goal is to create a balance between the two and bring about outcomes that are not only effective but long-lasting. I endeavour to do this through an evidence-informed approach, targeted education and mutual collaboration. I think of it as a partnership where we work together to actively create the best result possible.

feeds.title: Hand & Stone Canada » Massage Therapy
feeds.description: At Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spas, we create a revitalizing experience for each Guest that begins the instant we touch. As passionate professionals we work in harmony, applying simple, natural processes that promote well-being in all we do. In the Massage therapy blog find the latest massage therapy news, stories, massage tips, and massage discounts.

feeds.title: Massago Blog
feeds.description: Massago is Canada's first and most popular on-demand mobile massage service - bringing ­RMTs and clients together through an innovative mobile app that enables services to be delivered to the home or office on short notice.
